correctionToOurOwnDocs.whatWeHadClaimed: the market card advertises one version while the install resolves an older one during the release-age window
correctionToOurOwnDocs.whatActuallyHappens: the card advertised v0.1.3 from the daily catalog, and the install delivered 0.1.9 — the newest published version — because the market pins an exact version, and an exact spec bypasses minimumReleaseAge (measured separately)
correctionToOurOwnDocs.stillTrue: a bare `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-review-outbox` on the CLI still resolves the highest mature version, which was 0.1.3 at the time
correctionToOurOwnDocs.notMeasured: what the market's own update check does with a too-new version; dshmarket's lib/updates.js computes latestMaturityAt for that path, but the path was not driven

automationNotes: the 开始使用 login dialog intercepts clicks; Escape dismisses it once it has rendered, so automation must retry with waits rather than assume a single keypress

dsh-session-superagent was installed by accident during an earlier attempt because the wrong search field was filled; the throwaway profile made that harmless, and it independently proved the install path works
